Specification: This specification is a small TLC test module intended to check that TLC reports an error when evaluating the expression x \in Int when x is not numeric. The state consists of a single variable x, initialized to the string value "a", and the Init predicate also invokes Print to display diagnostic messages including the problematic membership test. The Next action leaves x unchanged and prints a failure message if execution were to continue, so the module is primarily a tooling/error-handling test rather than a full algorithm or protocol specification.
